meta.title: Get in Touch — UnLitigate
meta.description: Tell us what's happening. Two minutes. Plain words. You choose what to share. Please don't share any government-issued ID or bank details.

hero.heading: Tell us what's happening
hero.body: Two minutes. Plain words. You choose what to share.

items.heading: You fill a short form
items.body: Name, city, the kind of dispute, and a few lines on what's going on.

items.heading: We read it and reply
items.body: A person reads what you sent. We do not ask for ID or bank details.

items.heading: Learn about mediation
items.body: We share general, educational information about how mediation works. This is not legal advice and we do not assess your case. What you share is kept confidential, as explained in our Privacy Policy.

form.note: Please don't share any government-issued ID or bank details.

other.heading: Other ways
other.body: If a form is not right for you, write or send a message.
